name: mana
description: Frankie Ramirez's agent skills, cast as spells: multi-reviewer code review, PR feedback resolution without comment noise, replies that read like you typed them, comment removal, repo setup for GitHub, Linear, or Jira, maps of decision tickets, filing build tickets from a plan, building a ready ticket, opening a pull request with visual evidence, inbox triage, merge conflict resolution, and blast radius proofs.
